themeVariables.fontFamily: Apple SD Gothic Neo, Pretendard, Malgun Gothic, Noto Sans KR, sans-serif

themeCSS: .node rect, .node polygon, .cluster rect { rx: 10px; ry: 10px; } .cluster rect { stroke-dasharray: 0; stroke-width: 1.2px; } .cluster-label span, .cluster-label text { font-weight: 700; color: #3c4a63; fill: #3c4a63; } .edgeLabel { font-size: 12.5px; color: #3c4a63; } .flowchart-link { stroke-width: 1.6px; } .messageText { font-size: 13px; } .actor { stroke-width: 1.4px; } text.actor > tspan { font-weight: 700; } .sequenceNumber { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .labelText, .loopText, .loopText > tspan { font-size: 12px; } .er.entityBox { stroke-width: 1.2px; } .nodeLabel b { font-weight: 700; }
